nodes.label: Per-Trade Risk Sizing (0.5% / 8 positions)
nodes.rationale: 0.5% with 8 concurrent positions, not 1.5% with 4. Measured on Donchian Breakout Trail over 1724 trades and 4.9 years WITH the derisk ladder and halt breaker modelled: 1.5%/4 drives a 20% drawdown and trips halt_drawdown_pct, stopping the system for good; 1.0%/4 and 1.0%/8 also halt. 0.5%/8 survives at 12.8%/yr and a 15.3% peak drawdown, beating 0.75%/4 (8.5%/yr, 17.7%) on BOTH return and risk, because a trend book earns its Sharpe from breadth rather than from size per trade. Total heat falls: 8 x 0.5% = 4% versus 4 x 1.5% = 6%. A 37%-win-rate mechanism cannot be sized like a 50%-win-rate one.

nodes.label: Slippage Model (slippage_atr_frac 0.015)
nodes.rationale: Because amount = risk / (2*ATR), ATR cancels and this is really a flat tax of 2*frac on the risk staked: 0.06 charged 8.6-20.5 bps/fill where the measured book charged 0.4-2.7 — a ~3-5x overcharge consuming ~75% of the mechanism's measured per-trade edge. 0.015 is ~4 bps/fill at the median declared ATR, still six times the measured cost, deliberately, because spreads widen during the volatility expansion a breakout entry lands in and THAT is not measured. Do not cut it further without measuring that.

nodes.label: Research Horizons (restricted to 4h)
nodes.rationale: A horizon is searched only if its discovery universe can carry the test AND its plain-window control is powered; consistency_p is a binomial tail. Measured 2026-09-13: 4h p=2.4e-03 POWERED and kept, 1h p=3.2e-01 and 15m p=2.4e-01 both UNDERPOWERED and refused — the known-good rule itself cannot register on them at this channel length, so widening the search would spend two cores on a question the gate cannot answer.

nodes.label: scouts.strategy_leads / require_strategy_signal
nodes.rationale: Measured on 204 live decisions (2026-08-24..09-02): at the 4h horizon the blended analyst+strategy score returned -0.695% a call, won 34.6%, t=-3.84, and BOTH sides lost there (BUY -0.335%, SELL -1.117%), which market drift cannot produce — so analysts now choose among what a validated mechanism proposed rather than opening positions on their own. A lone signal could reach at most 0.6*0.45/1.45 = 0.186 in the blend, under every threshold the system produces. Analysts are still evaluated and journalled, so their skill stays measurable and this stays reversible.

nodes.label: Research Referee Gate (research.referee: false)
nodes.rationale: Off pending a gate decision (2026-09-14, plan Task 9): the known-good rule reads common-rotation p=0.049 on held-out B, so the referee as built cannot admit the incumbent, and switching it on would spend the LORD++ budget on looks that cannot succeed.
